locale.description: The language code of this translation, used to format names and times. Do not translate; use the code of the language of this file.

extDescription.message: Switch between Autodarts accounts on a shared display with one tap, without signing in again.
extDescription.description: The description of the extension, at most 132 characters.

badgeTitle.message: Player Switch for Autodarts – sign in again: $NAMES$
badgeTitle.description: The tooltip of the toolbar icon while accounts have to sign in again. $NAMES$ is a list of their names, such as 'Ada and Bob'.

renewed.description: When the extension last renewed the parked session of an account. $WHEN$ is a relative time, such as '3 hours ago'.

updateHintText.message: Autodarts may have changed how it signs in. Check for an update of Player Switch.

unsavedText.message: Someone is signed in on Autodarts who isn't saved here yet.

removeConfirm.message: Remove $NAME$ from this display? Sign in again to add the account back.

passwordHint.message: Only used when the saved sign-in stops working. It stays on this computer and goes only to Autodarts.

switchSignIn.message: $NAME$ has to sign in again: sign in once on Autodarts and save the account, or remember the password.

unreachable.message: Autodarts can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.

noPage.message: Open or reload play.autodarts.com in a tab, then try again.

empty.message: No accounts yet. Sign in on play.autodarts.com, then save the account here.

addHint.message: Signed out. Sign in on Autodarts with the next account, then open this again to save it.

error.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

keysHint.message: Keys 1 to 9 pick a player, Esc closes.

reloadAfterUpdate.message: Player Switch was updated. Reload the page to use it? A running match ends on this display.

matchText.message: Switching ends it on this display.

commandToggle.message: Open or close the switcher in the Autodarts page

optionsButton.message: The button in the Autodarts page

optionShowButton.message: Show the button on the Autodarts page

optionShowButtonHint.message: A tap on it shows the players over the page, also in fullscreen and kiosk mode, where the toolbar is out of reach. The keyboard shortcut opens them as well.
